descriptionByLocale.it:
• Mission As part of the Tax Services team, the Tax Specialist is a key element to ensure the quality and accuracy of the reporting done by the Bank, as a regulatory obligation, in an environment which is subject to constant changes and evolutions. Within the Daily Regulatory Reporting team, the employee’s mission also includes constant monitoring and reconciliation of the data to be reported. The tax and regulatory topics include MIFID II/ EMIR / FMIA / FINFRAG / Duty to disclose.
• Main responsibilities
• Daily monitoring and control of regulatory reporting (MIFID II / EMIR / FMIA / FINFRAG) sent to the reporting platform(s) (i.e. locals regulators)
• Monthly reconciliations, quality control and statistics of the data reported
• Manage inquiries and investigate questions and issues about the taxes or regulatory reporting from other departments of the Bank or from external counterparties
• Understand regulatory risk sensitivity and has an end-to-end view of the Bank’s flow/process
• Correction of consistency issues, update reporting tool’s database
• Liaising and coordinating with the department responsible for the underlying data for the necessary corrections, explanations, data input and resubmission of the corrected report(s)
• Communication with the reporting engine providers (ARM, APA, TR)
• Performing regular and ad-hoc reporting related to statistics for internal and external parties
• Contribute to all testing linked to regulatory and reporting updates
• Active participation in EMIR/MIFID/DTD projects (Audit inquiries, Provider specifications changes & Regulator inquiries) including data mining and in-depth investigation
• Open mind and team orientation: Be open to other’s ideas. Express and accept constructive criticism.
• Innovation and development: Propose and seek improvement of the current tools and processes. Be positive towards change and seek opportunities to improve the quality of the working environment. Conitunuously work on knowledge improvement.
• Corporate culture: Be ‘solution oriented’ and have a strong sense of customer services. Be proactive and driven. Developp and maintain a relationship network within the various Bank departments. Comply consistently with internal and external regulations.
• Your Profile
• Good knowledge of the financial products and associated transactions
• 3-5 years of experience in banking or financial services
• Project management experience
• Strong Excel, Access skills
• Strong analytical skills, able to make complex data reconciliation
• Ability to efficiently manage priorities
• Be able to work independently but also as a team
• Seek opportunities to improve the existing set-up
• Go beyond specific assignments, walk the extra mile
• Consistently comply with internal & external regulations
• Maintain quality standards despite schedule pressures
• Fluent in French and English
• Others
• Swiss Residence Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

descriptionByLocale.it:
• Mission
• The Middle Officer in Asset Management acts as the central point of contact for operational queries, ensuring timely client responses and smooth transaction processing. Key responsibilities include trade matching, settlement follow-up, daily reconciliations, collateral management, and issue resolution. The role also involves producing activity reports, collaborating with counterparties, and implementing new processes to enhance operational efficiency.
• Main responsibilities
• Act as the central point of contact for operational queries, and always available to respond to our client queries in a timely manner
• Securities & FX trade matching, instruction to relevant third parties and settlement follow-up
• OTC & ETD trade matching, and clearing monitoring
• Produce the daily activity reports to third parties
• Perform daily reconciliations of portfolio positions, cash balances and transactions.
• Breaks analysis, investigation until resolution
• Participation in the implementation of new processes and controls
• Oversee the daily management of collateral for derivatives
• Perform daily reconciliations of collateral balances with counterparties, resolving discrepancies in a timely manner.
• Collaborate with counterparties, clearing brokers, and custodians to ensure smooth collateral movements and settlements.
• Your Profile
• +5 years of experience in Asset Management / Operations or FX activities
• University degree(s) in accounting, finance and/or business management
• Strong knowledge of fund structures, share class operations, and regulatory frameworks (e.g., EMIR, UCITS, AIFMD).
• Deep understanding of currency markets, hedging instruments (e.g., forwards, swaps), and collateral management practices.
• Specific competencies
• Strong Analytical skills and problem-solving skills.
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate across teams.
• High attention to detail and ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment.
• Awareness of risks and focus on risks mitigation techniques
• Rigour and organization skills
• Result oriented, driven to succeed
• Ability to work in a dynamic, high demand environment
• Fluent in French and English, other language(s) a plus
• Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver results within tight deadlines.
• Proactive mindset with a focus on continuous improvement and innovation.
• Swiss residency Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

• Express opinions and criticism in a constructive way
• Be a continuous learner
• Adaptability, self-motivation and teamwork

descriptionByLocale.it:
The Group’s risk management activities are overseen by Group Risk Management, led by the Group Head of Risk Management (Chief Risk Officer / CRO). In Switzerland, Group Risk Management teams are responsible for overseeing the Bank’s activities, while ensuring local alignment with Group standards at an international level. They coordinate methodologies, implement transversal risk management initiatives and lead key local projects in close collaboration with Group-level risk representatives. The Swiss Risk Management function is structured into specialized teams covering Treasury & Trading, Asset Management, Wealth Management and Operational Risk. In addition a dedicated Project team provides cross-functional support for key initiatives led by the CRO or team heads. Acting as a second line of defense, the Risk teams serve as trusted advisors to the Business, participate to local committees, perform independent controls and support the definition and implementation of mitigation plans in coordination with risk owners (1st line of defense). Mission As of 1 September 2026, Union Bancaire Privée (UBP) is offering a permanent position within its Group Risk Management teams (2nd line of defense) in Geneva, starting with a 12‑month training program that includes regular interactions with other Bank functions and Legal Entity representatives across the Group. The purpose is to acquire targeted professional skills as well as practical experience with a strong orientation on risk management and secondly on project management.
• Rotations: The program includes four, three-month rotations across different teams.
• Main responsibilities During the program, under the supervision of the team managers in their role of mentor, the Graduate is expected to provide support on all teams’ activities as well as assist them in their daily tasks, with in particular:
• Gain hands-on experience in the oversight of control framework and risk assessments across Wealth Management activities
• Build a strong foundation in risk management framework and contribute to the continuous enhancement of risk and control methodologies
• Perform control activities and deliver clear and insightful analysis to internal stakeholders
• Get involved in projects and support their implementation
• Contribute to thematic reviews and identify value-added improvement opportunities
• Contribute to the improvement of risk management reporting to Senior Management and communication methods with the 1 LoD (the Business) through innovative, technology-driven enhancements. During the program, you will also have the possibility to start a certification related to Banking sector and/or your function, for examples the CFA (Chartered Financial Analyst) or CIA (Certified Internal Auditor), further enhancing your professional development. Your Profile Background
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in finance, business management recently obtained from a highly recognised university or equivalent.
• Maximum 12-months’ professional experience. Knowledges
• Good understanding of banking / financial sector, interest for Private Banking model and challenge / regulations.
• Knowledge of risk management and/or control activities an expectation.
• Experience in project management a plus.
• Strong analytical skills, strong presentation skills. Technical Skills
• Excellent knowledge of the Microsoft Office tools especially Excel, PowerPoint.
• Knowledge in Power BI a plus.
• Fluent in English and French (minimum C1 in both). Specific Competencies
• High motivation, attention to details, excellent organization skills and strong attention to deadline
• Discretion as a need-to-have
• Multi-tasking and solutions oriented
• Very strong team spirit and capable to work independently
• Candidate must hold a valid work permit or be eligible to work in the locations
• Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives. Applications
• Applications must include a CV, diploma(s) and a cover letter.

Investments Data Analyst - Portfolio Guardian 12 months temporary mission About COO Investment Management:
• The COO Investment Management department at Union Bancaire Privée (UBP) is the operational backbone of the bank’s investment platform. It orchestrates the strategy, governance, processes, data, and technology that enable UBP’s investment teams to deliver high-quality, compliant, and scalable outcomes for clients across discretionary, advisory, and fund management activities.
• Mission You will Work inside the Investments COO Investment Management (COO IM) Office and engage with our Buy-Side stakeholders, Discretionary Portfolio Managers (DPM), Product Specialists and Buy Side Analysts. As a Portfolio Guardian, your mission is to safeguard the integrity, consistency, and client alignment of our managed portfolios across their entire lifecycle. You will act as the first line of defense for portfolio quality — ensuring that investment intent is faithfully implemented, risks are understood and controlled, and mandates remain compliant with guidelines and regulations. You will also architect, build, and deploy high-impact software solutions in fast-moving, high-stakes environments inside the Investment Project and Tools team. You operate as a force multiplier across the stack — rapidly assessing the terrain, selecting the right tools, and executing with precision to deliver secure, resilient, and mission-critical capabilities.
• Main responsibilities Portfolio Guardian
• Take ownership of risk/breach dashboards and other Discretionary Portfolio Management (DPM) solutions, including end-to-end oversight of underlying data-sourcing processes.
• Create solutions that support Portfolio Managers in managing their discretionary mandates.
• Manage existing discretionary models and datasets, ensuring analytics tools correctly source, reconcile, and integrate data from external providers and cross-functional systems.
• Maintain First Line of Defence (LOD1) risk controls and produce high-quality presentations and reports for DPM leadership and internal teams.

Union Bancaire Privée (UBP) is a leading Private Bank specializing in Wealth Management (WM), offering tailored financial solutions to a diverse international clientele. Data analytics plays a key role in strengthening operational oversight, improving client understanding, and enhancing compliance and risk management processes. As a WM Data Scientist within the COO Wealth Management office, you will work at the intersection of data science, WM operational processes, and compliance analytics. The role focuses on analyzing internal data to identify patterns in client activity, operational workflows, and risk indicators, helping the organization better detect anomalies, improve client monitoring frameworks, and strengthen decision-making. This position goes beyond traditional reporting. You will apply statistical methods, behavioral analytics, and quantitative modelling to improve rule-based monitoring frameworks, support client lifecycle analytics, and optimize operational risk controls. The role also includes contributing to the definition of analytical frameworks and data specifications that will support future AI initiatives within the Wealth Management COO organization. Mission Development of intelligent analytical solutions to complex operational and risk-related problems by extracting, transforming, modelling, and analysing data across multiple banking systems. The role focuses particularly on analytical challenges at the intersection of WM operations, compliance monitoring, and business risk controls, including the optimisation of monitoring alerts and detection frameworks. You will be mentored by the Head of WM Reporting & Dashboards located in our Zurich office, with occasional travel to Geneva. Main responsibilities
• Extract, transform, and structure data from multiple internal banking systems and operational processes
• Perform advanced statistical analysis and data exploration to identify behavioural patterns in client activity and operational processes
• Analyse and refine rule-based monitoring scenarios and threshold parameters used in transaction monitoring frameworks
• Develop quantitative models and analytical approaches to improve client segmentation, lifecycle analysis, and risk indicators
• Contribute to the optimisation of monitoring alerts and detection frameworks related to client activity and transaction behaviour
• Translate analytical findings into clear insights and recommendations for operational, compliance, and management stakeholders
• Contribute to defining analytical specifications and data frameworks supporting future advanced analytics and AI initiatives Qualifications
• Academic degree (BA/MA) in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field
• At least 5 years of experience in a similar role
• Banking experience strongly preferred, or experience in a similar data science environment
• International work experience desired for this role
• Fluent in English; additional languages are an advantage
• Experience working with large datasets and applying statistical or quantitative methods to operational, compliance, or risk-related problems
• Experience analysing rule-based monitoring frameworks, risk indicators, or behavioural patterns in financial data is highly valued
• Strong technical skills in SQL and Python
• Experience with data visualisation or business intelligence tools (e.g. Power BI) is beneficial but not the primary focus of the role
• Exposure to transaction monitoring, KYT/KYC processes, or compliance analytics is a must
• Strong analytical and curious mind with excellent research, communication, and presentation skills
• Self-discipline, quality conscious and goal-oriented approach and readiness for an agile working environment Candidates must have the legal right to work in Switzerland at the time of hire. This position is 100% on-site in Zurich, Switzerland. Start: asap

• Job Summary
• The Securities Master File Specialist is a critical role within the bank, responsible for managing and maintaining the integrity of financial instrument data across Wealth Management and Asset Management businesses. This role ensures the accurate and timely setup, maintenance, and monitoring of securities and benchmarks, supporting front office teams, risk management, operations, and client reporting.
• In addition to the core responsibilities, the Securities Master File Specialist will play a pivotal role in the project to replace the current tool managing the securities master file . This includes contributing significantly to the success of the project by actively participating in testing, data migration validation, and supporting the adoption of the new platform.
• The ideal candidate will have a strong attention to detail, excellent analytical skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively with internal and external stakeholders. The role also involves active participation in project management initiatives to enhance processes, systems, and data quality.
• Key Responsibilities
• Securities and Prices Management
• Open and update financial instruments in the database, ensuring accuracy and completeness.
• Process requests for new instrument setups from various business units, including Private Banking, Asset Management, Treasury, and Trading.
• Conduct thorough analysis and research of additional information (e.g., prospectuses, offering documents, term sheets, and data providers).
• Enter and maintain additional information in the Instruments Database.
• Manage and monitor prices and Net Asset Values (NAV) per share.
• Perform regular controls to ensure data quality and integrity.
• Data Quality Assurance
• Execute daily, weekly, and monthly processes and controls to maintain a high level of data quality service.
• Ensure data accuracy to support front office teams, risk management, and operations.
• Participate in the implementation of new procedures, projects, and controls.
• Document all processes with operational procedures (including process flows, risks, controls, and key performance indicators).
• Role in the Securities Master File tool replacement project
• Testing and Validation:
• Actively participate in defining and executing test cases for the new platform.
• Analyze test results, identify anomalies, and collaborate with project teams to resolve issues.
• Ensure the new tool meets functional and operational requirements.
• Data Migration and Quality Control:
• Validate the accuracy and completeness of data migrated to the new platform.
• Perform detailed checks to identify and address discrepancies in the migrated data.
• Change Management and User Support:
• Contribute to the development of user guides, training materials, and process documentation for the new tool.
• Provide training and support to end-users to ensure a smooth transition to the new platform.
• Act as a key point of contact for feedback and troubleshooting during the implementation phase.

• Behave Ethically
• Communicate Effectively
• Foster Teamwork
• Creativity/Innovation
• Organize
• Plan
• Lead / Manage
• Make Decisions
• Solve Problems Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

descriptionByLocale.it:
Main Responsibilities The UK Regulatory Compliance Team is primarily responsible for providing timely, risk-based advice, challenge, and enablement to the business on regulatory matters. The Investor Protection Compliance team sits within UK Regulatory Compliance and assists in managing compliance risk across UBP UK, contributing to regulatory change implementation, and helping to maintain effective policies, training, and governance in line with UK requirements and UBP standards relating to investor and client protection. Investor Protection Compliance ensure investors and clients are treated fairly and transparently, topics include but are not limited to; disclosures, suitability & appropriateness, conflicts of interest, complaints handling, marketing and client communications, vulnerable customers, responsible lending, product governance and best execution.
• The role holder is responsible for:
• supporting the team in fulfilling the responsibilities set out above.
• supporting the team and assisting in the management of compliance risk across UBP UK’s business. In providing advisory support, the role holder will liaise with colleagues in the UK Regulatory Compliance team, Financial Crime and overseas offices as appropriate to ensure local regulations and wider department processes are considered.
• providing advice and enabling support and independent challenge to any areas of the UBP business or any topics as agreed with management. The role holder will also be expected to support business projects and provide cover for other members of the team as required.
• coordinating team activities, including but not limited to managing the mailbox and query management, new product and service reviews, product and service ongoing reviews and financial promotions.
• reviewing financial promotions, marketing materials and client facing communications.
• initial reviews and coordinating the update of relevant policies and processes considering UK regulatory requirements and market and business development
• assisting with the analysis of regulatory issues arising and implementation of relevant projects and regulatory changes
• working with and supporting the team, to respond to advisory queries, upgrade and implement policies considering regulatory developments, and contribute to risk assessments, training and internal governance reporting activity as required. Role Duties Investor Protection Compliance support and coordination:
• Assist in monitoring external regulatory and business developments and help develop and implement policies and procedures to reflect new requirements
• Support in analysis of regulatory developments where required for investor protection topics
• Assist in analysing and preparing for the impact of upcoming regulatory developments
• Contribute to compliance reporting, dashboards, and management updates, ensuring data is timely, accurate, and consistent.
• Contribute to improving the process and procedures to meet consumer duty principles and other conduct requirements within the regulatory framework, Treating Customers Fairly and sound risk management
• Provide stakeholders with sound and timely advice, guidance and support, where appropriate.
• Assist in the Regular review of Investor Protection related Policies and other written guidance.
• Assist in evaluating and progressing proposed new products/ services and other business initiatives.
• Assist in developing and maintaining training, communications, and guidance that translates regulatory expectations into practical steps for the business.
• Initial review and investigation, where required, of escalations from business assurance relating to; cross border, client-opt ups, suitability and appropriateness.
• Review of regular reports related to complaints from business assurance
• Help to identify regulatory compliance risks. Team Management and Collaboration:
• Uphold the UBP values and, by example, support culture of compliance with policies, appropriate risk management and the principle of treating customers fairly.
• Support management and the team through active participation in regular team and 1-2-1 meetings
• Partner with business stakeholders to support compliance objectives and business enablement
• Participate in group projects as appropriate and required
• Work within the team to help identify areas for improvement and efficiency
• Support the Compliance team and act as cover for other members where required. Business & Market Knowledge
• Develop and sustain technical knowledge across the products and services of UBP to ensure business is supported.
• Retain updated personal knowledge of wealth management/private banking market, ensuring that the reputation of UBP is upheld to the highest level possible in terms of compliance and reputation internally and externally and to consider treating customers fairly and good customer outcomes. Internal Control
• Maintain full, accurate files/notes of key meetings and advice using UBP core systems to store.
• Help log, triage, and track compliance issues, incidents, and inquiries
• Support root-cause analysis and follow-up actions under guidance from senior team members. The job description is not exhaustive and may include other duties as assigned from time to time by management. Specific duties may evolve based on business needs, regulatory changes, and the candidate’s strengths and interests. Committee Membership
• None Conduct Rules This role is required to comply with the Financial Conduct Authority’s (FCA) Individual Conduct Rules, which are:
• To act with integrity;
• To act with due skill, care and diligence;
• To be open and cooperative with the FCA, the Prudential Regulation Authoritity (PRA) and other regulators;
• To pay due regard to the interests of customers and treat them fairly;
• To observe proper standards of market conduct; and
• To act to deliver good outcomes for retail customers. Person Specification Knowledge, Skills & Experience
• Good understanding of UK financial regulations including but not limited to: MiFID II, Consumer Duty, FCA rulebook
• Compliance qualifications (ICA or CISI) desirable
• 2 years+ Financial Services experience preferable
• Wealth management experience is desirable
• Ability to assess and analyse information
• Ability to interpret regulation, identify risks and analyse potential control gaps
• Strong attention to detail and focus
• Good written & communication skills
• Numeracy, drafting and record keeping
• Team Spirit & Collaboration
• Attention to detail and focus
• Good project / change management skills

Main Responsibilities The UK Regulatory Compliance Team is primarily responsible for providing timely, risk-based advice, challenge, and enablement to the business on regulatory matters. The Investor Protection Compliance team sits within UK Regulatory Compliance and assists in managing compliance risk across UBP UK, contributing to regulatory change implementation, and helping to maintain effective policies, training, and governance in line with UK requirements and UBP standards relating to investor and client protection. Investor Protection Compliance ensure investors and clients are treated fairly and transparently, topics include but are not limited to; disclosures, suitability & appropriateness, conflicts of interest, complaints handling, marketing and client communications, vulnerable customers, responsible lending, product governance and best execution.
• The role holder is responsible for:
• supporting the team in fulfilling the responsibilities set out above.
• supporting the team and assisting in the management of compliance risk across UBP UK’s business. In providing advisory support, the role holder will liaise with colleagues in the UK Regulatory Compliance team, Financial Crime and overseas offices as appropriate to ensure local regulations and wider department processes are considered.
• providing advice and enabling support and independent challenge to any areas of the UBP business or any topics as agreed with management. The role holder will also be expected to support business projects and provide cover for other members of the team as required.
• coordinating team activities, including but not limited to managing the mailbox and query management, new product and service reviews, product and service ongoing reviews and financial promotions.
• reviewing financial promotions, marketing materials and client facing communications.
• initial reviews and coordinating the update of relevant policies and processes considering UK regulatory requirements and market and business development
• assisting with the analysis of regulatory issues arising and implementation of relevant projects and regulatory changes
• working with and supporting the team, to respond to advisory queries, upgrade and implement policies considering regulatory developments, and contribute to risk assessments, training and internal governance reporting activity as required. Role Duties Investor Protection Compliance support and coordination:
• Assist in monitoring external regulatory and business developments and help develop and implement policies and procedures to reflect new requirements
• Support in analysis of regulatory developments where required for investor protection topics
• Assist in analysing and preparing for the impact of upcoming regulatory developments
• Contribute to compliance reporting, dashboards, and management updates, ensuring data is timely, accurate, and consistent.
• Contribute to improving the process and procedures to meet consumer duty principles and other conduct requirements within the regulatory framework, Treating Customers Fairly and sound risk management
• Provide stakeholders with sound and timely advice, guidance and support, where appropriate.
• Assist in the Regular review of Investor Protection related Policies and other written guidance.
• Assist in evaluating and progressing proposed new products/ services and other business initiatives.
• Assist in developing and maintaining training, communications, and guidance that translates regulatory expectations into practical steps for the business.
• Initial review and investigation, where required, of escalations from business assurance relating to; cross border, client-opt ups, suitability and appropriateness.
• Review of regular reports related to complaints from business assurance
• Help to identify regulatory compliance risks. Team Management and Collaboration:
• Uphold the UBP values and, by example, support culture of compliance with policies, appropriate risk management and the principle of treating customers fairly.
• Support management and the team through active participation in regular team and 1-2-1 meetings
• Partner with business stakeholders to support compliance objectives and business enablement
• Participate in group projects as appropriate and required
• Work within the team to help identify areas for improvement and efficiency
• Support the Compliance team and act as cover for other members where required. Business & Market Knowledge
• Develop and sustain technical knowledge across the products and services of UBP to ensure business is supported.
• Retain updated personal knowledge of wealth management/private banking market, ensuring that the reputation of UBP is upheld to the highest level possible in terms of compliance and reputation internally and externally and to consider treating customers fairly and good customer outcomes. Internal Control
• Maintain full, accurate files/notes of key meetings and advice using UBP core systems to store.
• Help log, triage, and track compliance issues, incidents, and inquiries
• Support root-cause analysis and follow-up actions under guidance from senior team members. Specific duties may evolve based on business needs, regulatory changes, and the candidate’s strengths and interests. Committee Membership

• To act with integrity;
• To act with due skill, care and diligence;
• To be open and cooperative with the FCA, the Prudential Regulation Authoritity (PRA) and other regulators;
• To pay due regard to the interests of customers and treat them fairly;
• To observe proper standards of market conduct; and
• To act to deliver good outcomes for retail customers. Person Specification Knowledge, Skills & Experience
• Good understanding of UK financial regulations including but not limited to: MiFID II, Consumer Duty, FCA rulebook
• Compliance qualifications (ICA or CISI) desirable
• 2 years+ Financial Services experience preferable
• Wealth management experience is desirable
• Ability to assess and analyse information
• Ability to interpret regulation, identify risks and analyse potential control gaps
• Strong attention to detail and focus
• Good written & communication skills
• Numeracy, drafting and record keeping
• Team Spirit & Collaboration
• Attention to detail and focus
• Good project / change management skills

Environment: The Structured Products Team of the Treasury and Trading Department is in charge of the issuance process, the hedging and the monitoring of the structured products issued by the bank. The team is also in charge of the trading of OTC Equity Derivatives such as Equity Options and Equity Accumulators/Decumulators. This junior position provides a great opportunity to join a dynamic team on the trading floor and to strengthen your skills in OTC Equity Derivatives and Structured Products trading. As a Junior Derivatives & Structured Products Specialist, you will support the team in all its business activities, and you will reinforce your knowledge and experience about capital markets and OTC Equity Derivatives and Structured Products trading. Mission:
• Trading of OTC Equity Derivatives such as OTC Equity Options and Equity Accumulators/Decumulators.
• Structuration, hedging and trading of the structured products issued by the bank (cross-asset with a strong focus on equity linked products).
• Monitoring of the structured products lifecycle management (underlying performance, corporate event, coupon, early redemption and maturity redemption).
• Improvement of the structured products issuance and the OTC derivatives trading processes automation. Main duties:
• Trading of OTC Equity Derivatives such as OTC Equity Options and Equity Accumulators/Decumulators.
• Trading of structured products and their hedges with internal and external counterparties on the primary and secondary markets.
• Development of IT tools to increase trading efficiency and to avoid operational risks.
• Assistance to the team for regulatory and legal aspects (Termsheets, Key Information Documents, Target Markets, …). Profile: Previous experience of 1 to 3 years in trading OTC Equity Derivatives and Structured Products Education: Master degree with a specialization in Finance is a strong plus Excellent knowledge of Excel and Bloomberg Programming skills in VBA is a plus High Motivation, high attention to detail Excellent entrepreneurial and organizational skills Quantitative, analytical and flexible Very strong team spirit and ability to partner with other teams Fluent in French and English Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

descriptionByLocale.it: Job Description (Please do not apply if you require a visa). We do not offer sponsorship. You will need a British passport/ Dual passport or ILR - Indefine leave to remain). This unique 12-month graduate programme is based in London and offers a permanent contract. The exceptional opportunity for a recent master’s graduate is designed to provide in-depth, practical exposure to various areas of the business within a renowned Private Bank. Created as a comprehensive learning experience, enabling you to gain valuable insights into the finance industry and develop essential skills for a successful career in private banking. The programme is structured around two rotations of 6 months – in the COO (Chief Operating Officer) team and Communications and Marketing team – after which the candidate will join the bank on a permanent basis. This programme is specifically focused on young graduates holding a master’s degree, with a maximum of 12 months of professional experience since graduation. Upon successful completion, you will have the opportunity to transition into a permanent role within one of the teams, continuing your career with the bank and applying the knowledge, networks, and experience gained during the programme in a role aligned to your strengths and interests. Role Description: The role will have a broad remit: • As part of the Communications team, the successful candidate will gain exposure to various initiatives designed to communicate effectively with internal and external stakeholders and promoting the brand. The candidate will report to Head of Communications and Marketing and will collaborate with the wider Communications team in the UK and in Geneva / other global locations. • The key areas of focus will include: • Preparing external and internal communications • Drafting briefing notes for spokespeople for media engagements and events • Supporting internal and client events • Supporting delivery of digital campaigns • In the COO team the successful candidate will report to the Head of COO Office Strategy and will get exposure to COO teams: Operations, Technology, HR, Legal, Change Management and Strategy. descriptionByLocale.en: Mission We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Tax Specialist to join our Client Documentation and Tax Services Department. descriptionByLocale.it: MISSION E MAIN RESPONSABILITÀ: Il ruolo generale del monitoraggio e del controllo delle imprese (BMC) è quello di garantire che le operazioni in atto siano il più efficace ed efficiente possibile. Ciò può comportare la revisione dei processi in atto e la valutazione per determinare i modi possibili del loro miglioramento. In qualità di Business Monitoring & Control Officer (BMC), sarai responsabile dell'implementazione e del mantenimento di misure di controllo robuste in diverse funzioni aziendali. La vostra esperienza sarà fondamentale per mitigare i rischi, garantire la conformità alle normative e migliorare continuamente. Potrai collaborare a stretto contatto con diversi dipartimenti, offrendo preziose informazioni e raccomandazioni per migliorare le prestazioni aziendali globali e mantenere la nostra reputazione come fornitore di servizi finanziari di fiducia. BMC-ufficiali considerano nel loro lavoro come garantire che l'azienda opera in modo che soddisfi le esigenze dei propri clienti in modo efficace e in linea con la governance della Banca. Essi controlleranno se la prima linea di compiti di difesa è stata eseguita correttamente e riferirà regolarmente alla seconda linea di difesa. Essi formano il legame tra i responsabili delle relazioni (RM) e gli organi di governo (ad esempio, Comitato di gestione e Consiglio di amministrazione) e altre unità. Un BMC-ufficiale svolgerà compiti amministrativi e contabili organizzando e coordinando i servizi bancari. TUO PROFILE: Istruzione: Laurea magistrale in finanza, bancario o economia, o esperienza equivalente.
